unresolved_notes.forthepeople.com: Excluded from every cohort. Morgan & Morgan holds an office here and in roughly a thousand other markets, and a profile on this site asserts one home market.
unresolved_notes.thetexasattorney.com: Bailey & Galyen. Eight of the addresses in the firm's own structured data are its Bedford headquarters, which is the Mid-Cities and Fort Worth side of the metroplex rather than Dallas. It has Dallas offices, but a firm's market is where it is based, and the market it is based in is not one this directory covers yet.
unresolved_notes.herrmanandherrman.com: Herrman & Herrman. Seven of the addresses in its structured data are Corpus Christi, with San Antonio, Brownsville and McAllen after it. Corpus Christi is the firm's market and Dallas is a branch of it.
unresolved_notes.daspitlaw.com: The Daspit Law Firm. Its structured data carries one address, 440 Louisiana Street in Houston. Houston is the market, not Dallas.
unresolved_notes.akfirm.com: AK Law Firm. Its structured data carries one address, 333 West Loop North in Houston, and its own title claims Texas rather than a city. Houston is the market.
unresolved_notes.mr.law: MR.LAW. Its site answers an automated reader over HTTPS with a 403 and only serves over plain HTTP, so nothing on it can be measured and G5 asks for a live HTTPS site. Not a judgement about the firm.
unresolved_notes.wilhitelawfirm.com: The Wilhite Law Firm. Six of its seven verified listings are in Colorado, headed by Denver, and its published number is a 303 one. Dallas is a branch of a Colorado firm.
